$description: Semantic radius and spacing roles. Both tiers are rem-based on a fluid root font-size.
idConvention: Token ids are dotted, lower-case, tier-prefix-free. Foundation ids are <category>.<name> (color.mainbg-dark, type.h1, spacing.1, radius.md, breakpoint.tablet, elevation.z-header, icon-size.header-logo, motion.transition.fast). Semantic ids are <role>.<variant> (text.primary, surface.page, border.hairline, accent.primary). Component ids start with component.<name>.<slot>, layout ids with layout.<name>. A "$ref" is always another token id.

radius.control.rationale: Every button: .btn-primary, .btn-outline, .btn-primary-stb, .ai__btn and the tag pills.

radius.card.rationale: The most used radius (9 site-authored uses): large cards and panels.

radius.panel.rationale: Mid-size panels and image frames (7 uses).

radius.block.rationale: Block-level corners (5 uses), including the left-only 2rem shorthand variant.

space.snug.rationale: 25 uses; also the inline gap on the composed /start and /auth button rows.

space.stack.rationale: The single most used spacing value (93 uses) and the desktop dots-field dot size and gap.

space.gutter.rationale: Second most used (71 uses); the horizontal page padding on section.tech.

space.page-top.rationale: padding-top on section.tech - the only top offset the four tech pages use.

space.page-break.rationale: 10 uses: the largest regular rhythm step.

space.pull-up.rationale: Most used negative step (5 uses): overlapping blocks.
